findings.name: rls_enabled_no_policy
findings.interpretation: RPC-owned tables intentionally expose no row policies; all private table API grants were separately checked and denied.

findings.name: anon_security_definer_function_executable
findings.interpretation: The only anonymous entry is existing rpc_get_legal_bundle, the deliberate signed-out legal-bundle read. Not a new109–123 grant.

findings.name: authenticated_security_definer_function_executable
findings.interpretation: Authenticated command/read endpoints are intentionally explicit SECURITY DEFINER APIs. This generic warning alone does not demonstrate bypass; the70 touched functions were checked against source boundaries.

findings.name: auth_leaked_password_protection
findings.interpretation: Leaked-password protection is reported disabled. This is an Auth configuration notice, not evidence of109–123 migration drift; no Auth setting was changed.

soleAnonymousFunction.detail: Function `public.rpc_get_legal_bundle()` can be executed by the `anon` role as a `SECURITY DEFINER` function via `/rest/v1/rpc/rpc_get_legal_bundle`. Revoke `EXECUTE` or switch it to `SECURITY INVOKER` if that is not intentional.

authConfigurationNotice.detail: Supabase Auth prevents the use of compromised passwords by checking against HaveIBeenPwned.org. Enable this feature to enhance security.

limitations: Read-only catalog and row-hash verification does not execute user journeys, application RPCs, providers or workers.
Function body MD5 values are retained as observations; the report does not claim independent runtime execution of every function body.
The first advisor sample was taken at115 while root promotion continued; only the final advisor sample is summarized here.
